sn4.8:1.2: I have heard that on one occasion the Blessed One was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
sn4.8:1.3: Then Māra the Evil One went to the Blessed One and recited this verse in his presence:
sn4.8:2.1:
“Those with children
delight
because of their children.
sn4.8:2.2:
Those with cattle
delight
because of their cows.
sn4.8:2.3:
A person’s delight
comes from acquisitions,
sn4.8:2.4:
since a person with no acquisitions
doesn’t delight.”
sn4.8:3.1:
The Buddha:
“Those with children
grieve
because of their children.
sn4.8:3.3:
grieve
because of their cows.
A person’s grief
comes from acquisitions,
sn4.8:3.4:
since a person with no acquisitions
doesn’t grieve.”
sn4.8:4.1: Then Māra the Evil One—sad & dejected at realizing, “The Blessed One knows me; the One Well-Gone knows me”—vanished right there.
